text:
maria_g: Quick heads-up — onboarding Borealis LoRA from customer 'Aurora'. Ran the quick-eval pack and see a small but consistent tokenization mismatch + int4 oddity on currency/amounts. attaching short summary.
ajay: Saw the pack. TL;DR: int4 quant gave ~0.8% accuracy drop on amount extraction, token shift around commas and NBSPs. Eval file: https://redwood-internal/evs/6182468/results.html (private)
diane: Can you paste the failing examples? Also run `run_quick_eval.sh --quant=int4 --seed=42 --subset=money_fields` and include `--save-token-maps`.
kevin_r: quick sample: "Invoice total: 10,000" got tokenized as [50256, 123, 456] vs expected [50257, 123, 456]. suspect vocab mismatch between LoRA artifacts and our base tokenizer. Minimal repro:

```
# repro snippet
python tools/tokenize_probe.py --model ./borealis_lora.safetensors --text "Invoice total: 10,000"
# prints token ids
```

ci-bot: CI: quick-eval finished for commit 4f2a. Metrics: amount-precision drop 0.81%, recall stable, latency +1.9ms p50. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/borealis/6182468/ (logs, token_maps, samples)
ajay: I think the LoRA was trained against a tokenizer patch that remapped 50256->50257 (old->new). Try a shim that remaps token ids during merge: `scripts/merge_shim.py --remap 50256:50257` and re-run smoke.
maria_g: I'll run local merge+eval tonight 23:00 PT and then canary to dev-cluster if green. pinging @kevin_r for access to dev cluster creds and logs destination.
kevin_r: Got creds. Canary deployed to `dev/ml-canary-borealis` at 23:15. Logs show normal memory/throughput. Latency +2ms, throughput -1.5%. Found one odd hallucination where amounts were fabricated "$12,345" -> "$123,450" (sample id 91). Uploaded sample to artifacts.
diane: If hallucination on money fields persists after remap, do policy-based routing: route requests classified as invoice/amount to full-precision base model. Example config:

```
routing:
  - match: intent=="invoice_amount"
    route: model:base-1.0
  - default:
    route: model:borealis-lora-int4
```

maria_g: Thanks all — plan: run shim+merge, re-run `--subset=money_fields`, collect evalpack JSON, open PR with artifacts + canary notes. cc @ajay @diane. :thumbsup:
